summary: Version 2 compiles and passes the topology check. It draws the circle centred at O (radius 113.5 px) and the named paths F-A-O-B, F-D-E, B-E-C, B-D (solid) and O-D (dashed), with labels F, A, O, B, D, E, C. The critic scored it 0.92 with no high or medium issues. Its only remaining note is a low-severity suggestion to thicken strokes slightly (0.8pt to about 1.0pt), which is cosmetic.
